summary: Recommended containerized security variables: `postgresql_disable_tls: false`; `controller_pg_sslmode`, `gateway_pg_sslmode`, `hub_pg_sslmode`, `eda_pg_sslmode` set to `verify-full` for mTLS to the database; and `*_nginx_disable_https` and `*_nginx_disable_hsts` (controller, gateway, hub, eda) left `false`, which is also the default when absent.
questions: Which security variables should I set for containerized AAP?
How do I enforce mTLS to PostgreSQL in containerized AAP?

answer_card.title: Containerized security inventory variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
postgresql_disable_tls=false
controller_pg_sslmode=verify-full
gateway_pg_sslmode=verify-full
hub_pg_sslmode=verify-full
eda_pg_sslmode=verify-full
# keep HTTPS and HSTS on (defaults)
gateway_nginx_disable_https=false
gateway_nginx_disable_hsts=false
```
The same `_nginx_disable_*` variables exist for controller, hub and eda. A third-party database must be set up for mTLS separately.
